informal_statement: Issue #278: for PR #279's eligible candidates (periods 2, 5, 7, 8) racing by least remaining distance, an independent-clock update promotes each closure H/T times, and a global-reset update gives every promotion to one closure. Quieting the internal periods by q switches the reset winner to the external joint closure exactly at 2q > 8; under independent clocks the modal expression switches at the same threshold. So the receiver regime holds under both rules as the mode, and needs the reset rule only as the sole expression.
